footer.promise: We never alter your silhouette. Your live camera never leaves your device.

common.loadError: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

catalog.title: See clothes on a body like yours
catalog.lead: No photos or camera to start. Pick a body similar to yours, try the garment live if you like, and find your size with an honest recommendation.

body.pick: Pick a body similar to yours
body.pickHelp: By height and shape. Change it any time; there's no right one.
body.chooseToSee: Pick a body below to see the garment on it.

note.similar-model: Illustration on a reference body: shows how it looks, not how it fits you. That's what the size recommendation is for.
note.live-overlay: Quick preview: the garment is overlaid on your image, but it doesn't predict the real fit.
note.photorealistic: AI-generated image from your photo. The most realistic option, but texture and fit may not be exact.

live.intro: See the garment on you in real time. Everything happens on your device.
live.privacy: We only ask for the camera (no microphone). No image is sent to any server.
live.quickPreview: Quick preview — for a more realistic result, use your photo
live.unsupportedGarment: Live view works with torso and leg garments. For this one, use the similar body.
live.ratiosReady: Proportions ready to refine your size (optional).

hint.no-body: Stand in front of the camera
hint.show-hips: Make sure your shoulders and hips are visible

error.denied: We don't have permission to use the camera. You can enable it in your browser settings.
error.unavailable: We couldn't find an available camera.
error.unsupported: Your browser doesn't allow using the camera here.
error.model: We couldn't load the pose detector on this device.

photo.intro: Upload a photo to see a realistic AI-generated image. It's optional: you can buy without it.

checklist.title: Your photo, your rules
checklist.cropFace: I'll use the least identifiable photo possible: I can crop or blur my face in the next step.
checklist.neutralBackground: The background is neutral and shows no personal information.
checklist.onlyYou: Only I appear in the photo.
checklist.ttl: The photo and result are deleted automatically in {{hours}} hours, unless you save the result to your account.
checklist.noTraining: We never use your photo to train models without separate permission.
checklist.deleteAnytime: You can delete it at any time.

face.legend: What should we do with your face?
face.notFound: No face detected. You can crop manually from the top.

photo.readyToGenerate: Your photo is ready. Generation takes 10 to 70 seconds.
photo.generatingHint: Feel free to check the size and reviews meanwhile.
photo.resultAlt: Generated image of the garment on your photo
photo.resultNote: AI-generated image: shows how it looks, not how it fits. Texture may not be exact.

fallback.title: We couldn't generate the image right now
fallback.body: The service is slow or unavailable. Meanwhile, you can see the garment on a similar body or try it live.

error.tooBig: The image is too large (15 MB max).
error.unreadable: We couldn't read that image. Try JPG or PNG.
error.upload: We couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.

failed.title: Generation didn't finish
failed.body: Something was interrupted on the server. Your photo is still available: you can retry.

limitation.complexPattern: Complex print: the pattern may not be reproduced exactly in the generated image.
limitation.looseFit: Loose garment: AI may only approximate how it drapes.

fit.title: Is it my size?
fit.optionalHelp: Circumference in centimeters. The more you give, the more reliable the recommendation.
fit.usePose: Use the proportions the camera detected (numbers only, never the image) to reinforce the recommendation.
fit.remember: Remember my measurements on this device
fit.alternative: You're between two sizes; {{size}} could also work.
fit.overridden: You chose {{size}}. Your choice helps us improve recommendations for this brand.

error.height: Enter your height in centimeters (120 to 230).
error.generic: We couldn't calculate the size. Please try again.

basis.detailedChart: This garment has a detailed size chart
basis.betweenSizesLowStretch: You're between two sizes and the fabric barely gives: we suggest the larger one
basis.betweenSizesStretchy: You're between two sizes and the fabric is stretchy: we suggest the smaller one
basis.brandRunsSmall: Adjusted: shoppers of this brand usually pick one size up
basis.brandRunsLarge: Adjusted: shoppers of this brand usually pick one size down
basis.outsideChart: Your measurements fall outside this garment's chart: treat it as an approximation
basis.insufficientData: Not enough data for this garment: treat it only as a starting point

fabric.cottonJersey: Soft cotton jersey with some stretch.
fabric.oxfordNoStretch: Oxford cloth with no stretch: fits exactly per the chart.
fabric.woolCoat: Wool cloth, designed to wear over other layers.

reviews.title: How it fit other people
reviews.barLabel: {{small}} say it runs small, {{fit}} true to size, {{large}} runs large
reviews.empty: No fit reviews for this garment yet.
reviews.thanks: Thanks! Your review helps others choose their size.

compare.title: Compare garments
compare.empty: You haven't saved any garments yet. From any garment, tap “Save to compare”.

account.title: Your account
account.optional: You don't need an account to try on clothes. It's only for saving results.

consent.title: Allow my photos to be used to improve the models
consent.body: Off by default. If you turn it on, you could help the fitting room work better for bodies like yours. You can withdraw it any time.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Your account, photos and saved results are truly deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.done: Account deleted: {{deletedObjects}} files and {{deletedSessions}} sessions removed.

error.exists: That email already has an account.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

similar.title: Similar body
similar.body: We ask for nothing: no photo, no camera, no measurements. It's the default mode.

live.title: Live camera
live.body: All processing happens in your browser. We only ask for video (never audio) and the camera turns off as soon as you leave. No image is sent to any server; the detection model is downloaded from our own site.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.body: Before uploading you can crop or blur your face, and we strip metadata (such as location). The photo and result delete themselves in {{hours}} hours unless you save the result to your account. You can delete it sooner whenever you want.

measurements.title: Your measurements
measurements.body: Only height is required. We don't store your measurements on the server; on your device only if you tick “remember”.

training.title: Model training
training.body: We never use your photos to train models without separate permission, which is off by default.

deletion.title: Real deletion
deletion.body: Deleting your account removes your files from storage, not just a flag in the database.

body.title: Your body, as it is
body.body: We offer no filters or tweaks to alter your silhouette, and we never compare bodies between people. Our reference body catalog covers XS to 4XL.

admin.title: Dashboard

m.overrideHelp: How often people change the suggested size.
m.fallbackHelp: Generations that ended in an alternative.
m.noBodyTime: We don't measure time spent looking at one's own body: that would optimize the wrong thing.

admin.name: Name
admin.chartNote: Created with the standard XS–4XL size chart. The illustration and previews on all 12 bodies are generated automatically.
admin.bodiesRule: Product rule: the catalog must always cover XS to 4XL. The system won't let you delete a body if it breaks that coverage.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a row. Please wait a moment.
errors.generationTimeout: Generation is taking too long. You can retry or use the similar model.
errors.deletePhoto: Couldn't delete the photo. Please try again.
errors.deleteAccount: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
